results.title: 10 man MUBS edge debutants University of World Mission Frontier | 2026/27 UFL
results.description: University Football League 2026/27: A ten man Makerere University Business School (MUBS) overcame debutants University of World Mission Frontier 1-0 in Nsangi on Friday, 23rd October 2026. Joe Worrick Mbabazi was the hero with the all-important goal in the 77th minute.
